entities.name: Flann
entities.description: Ash treefolk of Lorwyn known as the Wanderer, giver of great knowledge; died of burns.

entities.name: Fionnsutha
entities.description: Young ash who inherited the mantle of Wanderer from Flann.

entities.name: Adair River Span
entities.description: Dear friend of Flann, searching for her unaware of her death.

events.summary: Flann is caught in a great forest fire, burnt and dying.
events.quote: Flann was caught in a great forest fire that left her burnt and dying

events.summary: Fionnsutha finds Flann, who passes on the mantle of Wanderer and her bag of magical tools before dying.
events.quote: Flann passed the mantle of Wanderer to Fionnsutha

relations.quote: Fionnsutha gives them much more cryptic advice than Flann would have
Flann was a dear friend of Adair River Span
